onChange.script:
try: 
        			    prevArr = [v.value for v in previousValue.value] if previousValue.value else []
        			    currArr = [v.value for v in currentValue.value] if currentValue.value else []
        			    #logging.log("Current Value {}".format(currentValue.value), "info")
        				
        			    # If two or more are True, keep only the one that just flipped True
        			    if sum(1 for c in currArr if c) > 1:
        			        # Find the index that changed from False -> True
        			        idx = next(i for i, (p, c) in enumerate(zip(prevArr, currArr)) if (not p and c))
        			        self.custom.checkboxAnswers = [(i == idx) for i in range(len(currArr))]
	except:
		return
